Action: ## Enter an article with multiple authors and multiple affiliations

Go to the "Enter Article Metadata" tab in the "Publisher Area"

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//publisher/metadata
In "Article Title" textbox enter "Study on Open Access Impact"
Enter valid Full-Text URL, eg "https://example.com/articles/oa-impact"
Select an Online ISSN from the dropdown
In Authors section, for the first author enter Name "Author 1", Affiliations "University of Oxford; Harvard University", and ORCID iD "https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789"
Click orange "Add more authors" button

Expected Test Results: A second author subform appears

Action: For the second author enter Name "Author 2", Affiliations "MIT; Stanford University; Cambridge University", and ORCID iD "https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3456-7890"
Fill in Publication Date (Year "2024", Month "06")
Click "Add Article" button

Expected Test Results: At the top of the page confirmation message "Article created/updated" is shown

Action: Navigate to the Table of Contents for the journal or search for the created article
Open the article's public page

Expected Test Results: Both authors "Author 1" and "Author 2" are displayed
Clicking "Affiliations" expands the affiliations accordion
Under "Author 1", "University of Oxford" and "Harvard University" are displayed on separate lines
Under "Author 2", "MIT", "Stanford University", and "Cambridge University" are displayed on separate lines
